card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 46 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 6.4 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 45.8 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,327 parsecs away.
